verdict_text:
YES

The script removes every `h.2.*`, `h.5.*`, `h.8.*` tensor, renumbers the surviving blocks in original order via the old-to-new map built from `enumerate(kept)` (3→2, 4→3, 6→4, 7→5, 9→6, 10→7, 11→8), leaves the four non-block tensors untouched, and passes tensors through unchanged so values, shapes and dtypes are preserved. It writes into a fresh dict, so no collision hazard exists. Both assertions run before `save_file`: the layer-index set must equal exactly {0..8} (which rules out any block 9, 10, 11 and proves exactly 9 blocks remain) and the tensor count must be 121, so any violation exits non-zero with no output written. The output lands at `out/T1/model.safetensors` as a single file.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
